summary: Tevogen Inc. filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, disclosing receipt of Nasdaq notice dated September 29, 2026, confirming regained compliance with the $50 million minimum market value of listed securities requirement under Listing Rule 5450(b)(2)(A) for the Nasdaq Global Market. This follows prior September 9, 2026 notice confirming compliance with the minimum market value of publicly held shares rule. Both compliance matters are now closed, and a press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated. The filing is a routine listing-compliance update, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle.
